super6.race: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
super6.comment: Had a productive 2024/25 season over fences, scoring back-to-back including over C&D. Lightly raced thereafter, again shaping a bit better than bare result (helped force strong pace) when third at Ludlow (3m) in February. Down to a handy mark and encouraging he's gone well fresh previously.

Off the mark in 4-runner novice at Ludlow (21f) last October and shaped with promise on second handicap start for Gary Hanmer in August. Given a considerate return on yard debut at Carlisle last month and she wasn't seen to best effect in rear at Uttoxeter earlier in the month. Should do better.
Looked badly in need of the experience in 1m maiden here last month and bred for longer trips.
Ended a lengthy losing run over C&D in July. Not disgraced off 4 lb higher mark when fourth of 14 in handicap at Kempton (1m) last month, having to pick his way through. Possibilities.

A 5-time C&D winner. Also scored at the Curragh (1m) in August for Adam Caffrey. Not at his best when eighth of 13 in 7f handicap here 21 days ago but handily weighted and not without interest with Caffrey back in the saddle.

super6.race: Unibet London Middle Distance Series (Final) Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
super6.comment: Won back-to-back sellers for William Haggas last year. Started off over hurdles for current yard, but completed a hat-trick in this sphere in a Southwell handicap in July. Placed over this C&D on 2 of 3 since, albeit with the run of the race when second on latest outing.

finals.race: Book Now For The BoyleSports Christmas Meeting Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: £34,000 5-y-o, Crystal Ocean mare. Dam unraced. Off the mark in Irish points at fifth attempt (Apr 2026).

finals.race: Book Now For The BoyleSports Christmas Meeting Mares' Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Showed only a bit more than on debut 14 lengths fourth of 5 in 2m bumper at Ffos Las (heavy) in March. Needs a big step forward now hurdling.

finals.race: Herefordshire Community Foundation Novices' Hurdle (GBB Race)
finals.comment: In hood for debut, looked a useful prospect when coming from last to first in a Warwick bumper in March. Defied a penalty in similar fashion at Ascot on his return, so he commands respect as he goes hurdling, even if it might be tougher to pull off the same tactics here.

finals.race: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Fair hurdler/chaser who typically finds plenty for pressure and he added a sixth success since May to his tally over hurdles at Catterick (25f) 5 days ago. Evidently thriving on his racing and another who can't be discounted now returned to larger obstacles.

finals.race: Join Racing TV Now Handicap Chase (GBB Race)

Lightly raced thereafter, again shaping a bit better than bare result (helped force strong pace) when third at Ludlow (3m) in February. Down to a handy mark and encouraging he's gone well fresh previously.

finals.race: Castle Sychrov Novices' Handicap Chase
finals.comment: Won pair of 2m handicap hurdles at Fakenham in 2024/25 but well held both completed starts over fences. Back on track reverted to hurdles when second of 6 here last month but failed to build on that at Windsor (2½m, good) since. Given another go chasing.

finals.race: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 1)
finals.comment: Won first 2 starts over hurdles for Dan Skelton (match race second occasion) but her form has gone the wrong way since and there's been no sign of a revival in 2 starts for current connections.

finals.race: Christmas Party Nights At Dundalk Stadium Handicap
finals.comment: Going through a good spell and made it 2 victories inside a month in C&D handicap a fortnight ago, doing it readily under this rider (first win under Rules, looked very good value for his 10 lb claim). Forced into a much higher grade now but can't be dismissed.

finals.race: Visit racingtv.com Handicap Hurdle (Div 2)
finals.comment: Off the mark in 4-runner novice at Ludlow (21f) last October and shaped with promise on second handicap start for Gary Hanmer in August. Given a considerate return on yard debut at Carlisle last month and she wasn't seen to best effect in rear at Uttoxeter earlier in the month. Should do better.

finals.race: Midnite A Next Generation Betting App Handicap (GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Comfortable 1m Southwell winner on debut in March. Runner-up on all-weather all 3 starts since, off 5 months but best effort on handicap debut there (1m) last time when also making her effort earlier than ideal. Likely more to offer now stepping up in trip. Player.

finals.race: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Fairly useful 3-time hurdle winner for this yard and ran well on rare start on the level when second (Queen of Astolat third) at Thurles last month. Finished weakly back over obstacles since but clearly on a fair back in this sphere and 2m should be fine.

finals.race: Dundalk Stadium Gift Vouchers Available Online Handicap (0-60)
finals.comment: Modest maiden who dropped away on hurdles debut at Ballinrobe in September when last seen. Stamina to prove for 2m back on the level (all-weather debut).

finals.race: Cuban Pete Celebration Handicap Chase (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Won his first 2 chase starts in late-2024 and firmly knocking at the door more recently, filling the runner-up spot for a third start in a row in 8-runner event at Southwell (3m, good to soft) earlier in the month. In the mix from the same mark.

finals.race: All-Weather Championship Is Back EBF Fillies' Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Sent off 25/1 but shaped well when a debut fourth of 13 in 6f novice at Wolverhampton 9 days ago. This Persian Force filly should build on it here. Well in the mix.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
finals.comment: Looked badly in need of the experience in 1m maiden here last month and bred for longer trips.

finals.race: Irish Stallion Farms EBF Maiden
finals.comment: Well held in pair of 1m maidens at the Curragh. Needs this run for a mark. RESERVE.

finals.race: Hampden Agencies Mares' Handicap Hurdle
finals.comment: Bred for further but was helped by her jumping when making all in a 2m mares novice at Ludlow on her third start over hurdles in May. However, after 6 months off she ran poorly sent handicapping when well held over this C&D in October.

finals.race: AWC Finals Day At Newcastle 26th March EBF Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB/GBBPlus Race)
finals.comment: Foaled April 2. Ghaiyyath colt. Closely related to 2-y-o 7.6f winner Neardown. Noteworthy newcomer from leading stable. Worth a market check.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Goes well at Dundalk, landing 7f handicap earlier this month and beaten just ¾ length in third last week. 1m fine and can give another good account under new rider.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
finals.comment: Ended 2-y-o season with 3 wins and picked up where he left off to bring up a 4-timer at Chester (7.5f) in May. Off 4 months/gelded, well-held eleventh of 14 in handicap at Ayr (1m, heavy) in September. Not written off on his tapeta debut.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
finals.comment: Ended a lengthy losing run over C&D in July. Not disgraced off 4 lb higher mark when fourth of 14 in handicap at Kempton (1m) last month, having to pick his way through. Possibilities.

finals.race: AWC Season 14 Has Begun Handicap
finals.comment: A dual 7f/1m winner (including here) at 2yrs when also a very good third in 1m Newmarket listed race in November. Off 12 months, never-dangerous fourth of 5 in handicap at Newmarket (1m, soft) last month. Needs to take a step forward.

finals.race: Book Online At DundalkStadium.com Handicap (0-60) (Div 2)
finals.comment: A 5-time C&D winner. Also scored at the Curragh (1m) in August for Adam Caffrey. Not at his best when eighth of 13 in 7f handicap here 21 days ago but handily weighted and not without interest with Caffrey back in the saddle.

finals.race: Racing TV EBF Fillies' Restricted Novice Stakes (GBB Race) (Div 1)
finals.comment: Foaled March 21. Lucky Vega filly. Dam, US 2-y-o 5.5f winner, granddaughter of Breeders' Cup Filly & Mare Turf winner Perfect Sting. Yard 8-52 this season with 2-y-o debutants at time of writing. Makes obvious appeal.

finals.race: Make The Move To Midnite Handicap
finals.comment: Back on the up following a break, gamely scoring over C&D in October before a clear second of 10 in 6f handicap at Southwell 30 days ago. That form has been franked so this low-mileage filly can go well again.

finals.race: Irishinjuredjockeys.com Handicap
finals.comment: Three-time C&D winner, who is now below last winning mark courtesy of an up-and-down 2026. Is a slightly more reliable proposition on all-weather and this represents a drop in class.

finals.race: Unibet/British Stallion Studs EBF Novice Stakes (GBB Race)
finals.comment: Blue Point gelding. Closely related to 3 winners, including top-class winner up to 7f Pinatubo and useful winner up to 1m Mountain Breeze. Dam 1¼m-11f winner. Already gelded but that no negative for these connections and he's a newcomer of extreme interest.

finals.race: Bet 20 Pound Get 20 Pound With Unibet Handicap
finals.comment: Off the mark at Wolverhampton (7f) in April and doubled her tally at Southwell (1m) in August when overcoming a pace bias. Excuses on her penultimate start but was below form in first-time cheekpieces at Southwell last month.

finals.race: Unibet Floodlit Stakes (Listed)
finals.comment: 3-time winner in 2025, landing a Group 2 at Newmarket in July before Grade 1 success at Saratoga. Hasn't been seen to best effect in his 3 outings this year, meeting trouble when down the field in the Breeders' Cup Turf at Keeneland last time. Major player back down in grade.
